description: CTA - Ridership - Bus Routes - Daily Totals by Route is a dataset listed in City of Chicago open data portal (data.cityofchicago.org), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Chicago. This dataset shows total daily ridership on a per-route basis dating back to 2001. Daytypes are as follows: W=Weekday, A=Saturday, U=Sunday/Holiday. See attached readme file for more detailed information. Coverage: Chicago. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are chicago transit authority, sustainability, public transit, cta, ridership. The table has 4 columns. Attribution on the portal: Chicago Transit Authority. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is see the terms of use on the portal (no named licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-cityofchicago-org-portal.
